headline: Bharat Bijlee Limited: Substantial Acquisition Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: Bharat Bijlee Limited filed a mandatory disclosure under SEBI Regulation 31(4) of the Takeover Code, signalling a substantial acquisition event requiring immediate reporting to the stock exchange.
detail: Bharat Bijlee, a Crompton Greaves-promoted electrical equipment manufacturer, submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure to NSE, which mandates notification when a person acquires shares crossing specified thresholds (typically 25%, 50% or 75%) in a listed company. The disclosure does not itself reveal the acquirer identity, consideration, or new holding percentage—those details are embedded in the regulatory filing itself. This is a gating step: within 4 working days, the acquirer must either file an open offer memorandum (if no exemption applies) or seek relief from SEBI. The filing confirms a material change in shareholding has occurred.
